verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, linked from its machine-readable llms.txt index. A hands-on probe fetched it with HTTP 200 and found a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 paths. Equivalents are also provided: a plain-text API reference (/llms-api.txt) and a Developer MCP server exposing OpenAPI schemas.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: GET https://docs.ramp.com/openapi/developer-api.json returns HTTP 200 — a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 documented paths
It gives AI assistants live access to Ramp's developer documentation, API reference, and OpenAPI schemas
